name: Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC)
description: Microsoft's security response center operating one of the largest vendor vulnerability reward programs across Windows, Office, Azure, Edge, and other products. Maintains public researcher recognition program.

peerReview.processDescription: Dedicated MSRC analysts triage all reports. Severity classification using Microsoft's Bug Bar (Critical/Important/Moderate/Low). Coordinated vulnerability disclosure with defined timelines.

attribution.attributionNotes: Acknowledgment page returns empty response as of 2026-09-24. Leaderboard URL returns empty response as of 2026-09-24. MSRC recognition is still provided through security advisories and CVE credits.

povsAlignment.description: Vendor vulnerability reward program with Bug Bar classification and researcher acknowledgment.
